answer.text: When riding solo, with only the rider and no load, set the rear suspension to the 3rd notch.
The manual also says the adjuster is kept at the first notch position, so the two values differ.
Confirm the correct notch with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.

policy.text: The suspension setting notch depends on whether the motorcycle is unladen or laden.
